💻 Use Desmos as a calculator

✅ Step 1: Type any arithmetic on its own line.
✅ Step 2: Got a decimal? Click the fraction button next to the answer to convert it to a fraction.
✅ Step 3: No need to switch apps.
✅ When to use it: 84000/1.12 → 75,000 instantly.
